assign.now: building the page — 9 tags catalogued, 3 deep-path walks confirmed via playwright, shots clipped and verified

log.msg: 9 mechanisms tagged: rail-nested (11 Sidebar sites), crumbs (5 direct + every columns host), tabs (38 sites, h+v), preview-wall (127 previews()+24 catalog()+4 browse()), columns-row (30 sites), prev-next (blogx only), toc-rail (23 call sites but CSS excludes .standard, the page default -- silently invisible in production), rail-scroll (blogx's own narrow-width answer, different from Sidebar's burger).

3 deep-path walks confirmed by real playwright clicks from cold /: blog post 5 segments deep = 4 clicks (no site-level trail carried, blogx owns its own chrome); doc/columns/ 6 segments deep = 4 clicks (sidebar in-path + h-tab underline + v-tab underline stacked, NO breadcrumb on doc pages unlike /notes/); columns Finder 4 deep = 3 clicks, no reload (crumb strip is the only surviving nav under 32em).

gaps found: toc() CSS explicitly excludes .standard (the page default) so it silently never renders on any of its 23 real call sites; the site's own app.js top-level .nav is hidden on every real destination (every topic declares hides-nav); /imagine/ is reachable from the homepage by exactly one markdown line at the page bottom, not from any rail; two different narrow-width answers exist for the same 'nested rail too tall' problem (Sidebar burger vs blogx horizontal-scroll) with no shared mechanism.

verify: 15 shot files referenced in page.js == 15 files in shots/ (deleted 4 unused: topnav-1280/390, columns-390, crumbs-390 -- superseded by rail-nested and columns-deep shots). shots/ total 648K, budget 2.5MB. assign.outcome: **Navigation study landed** — 9 mechanisms catalogued at 1280/390 (rail-nested, crumbs, tabs, preview-wall, columns-row, prev-next, toc-rail, rail-scroll), 3 real click-trails walked headless from a cold `/` (4, 4, and 3 clicks into 5-, 6- and 4-deep urls), one page: [Navigation study](/imagine/design/navigation/).
